_about: OUR recommendations, which are opinion and shown only when the reader turns on picks. verdict: "egg" (Golden Goose Egg, positive) or "honk" (Certified HONK, negative). For a measure, egg = vote YES and honk = vote NO. For an office or a retention vote, `target` names the candidate or justice being praised or warned against. Every pick needs `reasoning`. Schema: docs/data-model.md.
